description: REQUIRES prior wetax__session__login call with same account_link_id. 조회만 합니다. 기간 안의 신고 이력(신고 식별자, 신고일, 신고 상태, 관할 지자체, 납부 여부)을 돌려줍니다. 제출을 다시 보내기 전에 앞선 제출이 접수됐는지 여기서 확인합니다. Files: a document generated from this result, as Excel (xlsx) only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

output_formats.description: Optional. Also return this result as a file (Excel (xlsx)) in artifacts[] of the result. Omit it for data only.
